senses.gloss: तकारविपुला N. of a metre.

तक् €1. €2. P. Ved. (तकति, तक्ति)
—1 To fly (as an arrow or bird), rush at or upon; सर्गो न तक्त्येतशः Rv. 9. 16. 1.
—2 To laugh at, deride, scoff.
—3 To bear, endure.

तक a. Ved.
—1 Censured.
—2 Enduring.

तकु a. Ved. Approaching (गामुक), rushing along; पुरुमेधश्चित्
 तकवे नरं दात् Rv. 9. 97. 52.

तक्वन् a. Ved.
—1 Rushing, darting along; श्रुतं गायत्रं तकवानस्याहम् Rv. 1. 120. 6.
━m. A bird (especially a bird of prey); तक्वा न भूर्णिर्वना सिषक्ति Rv. 1. 66. 1.
—2 A fleet horse.
—3 A thief, rogue.
तकिल a. Fraudulent, crafty, rogue.
तकिल + .{@-ला@} A medicament, drug.
तक्कन् n. child, offspring. (तक्मन् ?).
तक्मन् m. N. of a disease; Av. (various Kāṇḍas).

तक्रम् Butter-milk; Ms. 8. 326; Y. 3. 37, 321; तक्रं शक्रस्य
 दुर्लभम् Subhāṣ.
.━{@Comp.@}: तक्राटः, तक्रकूर्चिका, तक्रपिण्डः, तक्रसारम्
तक्रम् + -अटः a churning. stick.
तक्रम् + -कूर्चिका Curds from milk boiled with whey.

तक्रम् + -पिण्डः The substance of butter-milk mixed with ¼th of water remaining
 after making it pass through a piece of cloth; curds; Bhāva P. 5. 13. 30.
तक्रम् + -सारम् fresh butter.

तक्ष् €1. €5. P. (तक्षति, तक्ष्णोति, तष्ट)
—1 To chop, cut off, pare, chisel, slice, split; आत्मानं तक्षति ह्येष
 वनं परशुना यथा Mb; निधाय तक्ष्यते यत्र काष्टे काष्टं स उद्घनः Ak.
—2 To
[]
 fashion, shape, form (out of wood &c.).
—3 To make, create in general.
—4 To wound, hurt; अन्योन्यं च शरैः क्रुद्धौ ततक्षाते परस्परम् Mb. 6. 45. 18.
—5 To invent, form in the mind.
—6 To make oneʼs own, appropriate.
—7 To cover.
—8 To peel.
—9 To make thin. ━With {@निस्@}
—1 to slice out of.
—2 to form, create.

तक्ष् a. (At the end of comp.) Paring, cutting &c.; also तक्ष;
 Bṛ. S. 87. 20, 24; also तक्षक q. v.; R. 15. 89.

तक्षकः [तक्ष् ण्वुल्]
—1 A carpenter, wood-cutter (whether by caste or profession).
—2 The chief actor in the prelude of a drama (i. e. the सूत्रधार).
—3 N. of the architect of the gods.
—4 N. of one of the principal Nāgas or serpents of the Pātāla, son
 of Kaśyapa and Kadru (saved at the intercession of the sage Āstika from
 being burnt down in the serpent-sacrifice performed by king Janamejaya,
 in which many others of his race were burnt down to ashes).

तक्षणम् [तक्ष् भावे-ल्युट्] Paring, cutting; दारवाणां च तक्षणम्
 Ms. 5. 115; Y. 1. 185.
तक्षणम् + .{@-णी@} A carpenterʼs adze.

तक्षन् m. [तक्ष्-कनिन्]
—1 A carpenter, wood-cutter (whether by caste or profession); तक्षा
 रिष्टं रुतं भिषग् Rv. 9. 112. 1; तक्षाणः पलगण्डाश्च … Śiva B. 31. 18;
 अताक्षा तक्षा K. P. one not a तक्षन् by caste is called
 तक्षन् when he acts like or follows the profession of a तक्षन
 (carpenter); Śi. 12. 25.
—2 N. of the architect of the gods.
ताक्षण्यः, ताक्ष्णः The son of a carpenter.
ताक्षण्यः, ताक्ष्णः The son of a carpenter.
